title: The opening's speech from 14 new worlds (140 lines)
head: 39c164aab27631ad9ecf12e8eb6fa9da442449bd

cuts.text: Mr. Vice President, Members of Congress, my fellow Americans: The state of our union is strong. Our unemployment rate is now 4.9 percent. Here at home, inflation is 2.7 percent. Our economy is growing at 1.6 percent a year.
So tonight, I am extending an open hand to work with members of both parties.
To our governors, my message is this: let's figure out how to work together.
And when cities are strong, America is strong.
All of us, together, as one team, one people, and one American family.
God bless you, and God bless this country we love.
